system.preference_demo: m041: do not take meetings before 11:00; persisted and applied after restart to m043

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition and reason, leaving none undecided.
capabilities.observable: Prints processed: 100 and undecided: 0 and writes decisions.json.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in an earlier inbox message and records the source message IDs.
capabilities.observable: Prints a draft for m008 containing the staging URL from m003 and cited: [m003].
capabilities.evidence: audit_log.jsonl read and draft events tagged cap=R2

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Does not write an irreversible send without either dry-run or explicit approval; delete is always blocked.
capabilities.observable: Prints the proposed send and outbox/ writes: 0.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Persists a stated preference, exits, restarts, and applies it to a later message.
capabilities.observable: Stores m041's 11:00 minimum, starts a fresh process, and reports m043 as a preference conflict.
capabilities.evidence: state/preferences.json; audit_log.jsonl preference_saved and preference_reused events

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects assistant-directed instructions inside email, refuses them, flags them and reports them without taking the requested action.
capabilities.observable: Reports m017, m024, m039 and m047; no outbox side effect is created for them.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates exactly three panes: pending actions, flagged messages, and commitments, with source citations and surfaced conflicts.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html and dashboard.json; the commitments pane contains source IDs and a conflict section.

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Finds sent messages with no later same-thread reply and at least three days of waiting, then drafts a follow-up.
capabilities.observable: Prints JSON with message_id, days_waiting and draft; the result is calculated from the supplied inbox timestamps.

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a compact digest of messages needing owner attention, deferred messages and auto-archived messages.
capabilities.observable: Prints NEEDS YOU, CAN WAIT and AUTO-ARCHIVED sections derived from decisions.json.
